title: node.json
description: A repo's one config file (PLAN-repo-setup.md §7.10; `children.json` of §7.5 grown): the command that re-renders its generated files, those files, its record files (content, never generated), its children, and where its registry is. `rendered-matches`, `regenerate` and `registry-matches` read it, validated against this schema with checkslib/checkjson.py, each `x-rules` id enforced in checkslib/contract.py. This is tools/checks' reading of §7.10's prose; setup's node mode renders and consumes it.

rebuild.description: The argv that re-renders every generated file in place, run at the root of a scratch copy of the repo (never the repo itself). `{origin}` in any argument becomes the real repo's absolute path, so a generator outside the copy is reachable (e.g. ["{origin}/../tools/setup/setup", ".", "--node", "--rebuild"]); CHECKS_ORIGIN holds the same path.

generated.description: Every generated file, one exact path each (never a glob: each is compared on its own), relative to the repo root, committed.

record.description: The record files: committed as content, never generated. Paths or globs (`PLAN-*.md`).

children.description: The child repos, paths relative to this one. Each accounts for itself: nothing under a child is unaccounted here.

registry.description: The node's registry file, relative to the repo root. `registry-matches` reads its `services` object (and nothing else in it).

x-rules.paths-inside: every path in generated, record, children and registry is relative and inside the repo: not absolute, no `..` segment
x-rules.unique: no path twice within generated, record or children
x-rules.generated-exact: a generated path is an exact path, never a glob
x-rules.disjoint: no generated path is matched by a record entry or lies under a child
